measurement.metric: Uncompressed UTF-8 bytes of the single JavaScript module entry referenced by out/renderer/index.html. CSS, dynamic chunks and source maps are excluded.
measurement.method: Built the unmodified release tag in a detached scratch checkout. Dependencies were symlinked from the existing installation without changing its node_modules symlink. The linked Vite, electron-vite and React versions match the tag's lockfile. No Electron process was launched.
cleanReproduction: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const root="/tmp/vomp-classic-baseline/out/renderer/"; const html=fs.readFileSync(root+"index.html","utf8"); const file=html.match(/<script[^>]*src="([^"]+)"/)[1]; console.log(file, fs.statSync(root+file).size);'
